notes.title: Calling all runners out there! 📢📢
notes.content:
Hirocato's version 2.0 is OUT! It includes a newly crafted feature where you'll be able to rewind time for a few seconds to fix falls, spike deaths, and complete cleaner, faster runs. 🔥⚡️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44159749/76f5908f0a0c3645f278d6c41ab4e70343b6c089.gif[/img]

I really hope this improves the Hirocato experience, making it more enjoyable and less ruthless 💛
Happy running, y'all! 🐱

notes.title: Build 1.1.7 is out !!
notes.content:
Hey Hirocatos, this new build includes:

- New Level Progression Logic: You can now play and progress through unplayed levels without having to complete the entire story. Just pass a level, and the next one will unlock!
- Crowd Control Integration: We've integrated Crowd Control into the Hirocato codebase! If you're a streamer looking for some chaotic but fun runs, there's now a dedicated option in the menu.
I hope these updates make the Hirocato experience even more enjoyable for everyone.

Bye!

notes.title: Difficulty selector is now a thing on Hirocato - The Delivery Hero
notes.content:
Hey Hirocatos! 📣 Update Announcement (Build 1.0.8)

I'm happy to announce a highly requested feature: the difficulty selector! 🎉
Now, when you access the pause menu, you'll find a difficulty selector with the following three options:

🔹 Normal: Long delivery times + more checkpoints
🔸 Hard: Fewer checkpoints, less delivery time
🔺 Hero: Limited time, no checkpoints

I hope these changes make the Hirocato experience more enjoyable for all of you. 🎮✨

notes.title: New non-stop mode out!! + bug fixes and improvements
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
I'm happy to announce that the first update for Hirocato - The Delivery Hero has been pushed and includes:

- New Classic Running (non-stop) mode 🚀
- Improved visual effects/filters that do not interfere with gameplay 📷
- Camera distance option added to the pause menu (Close, Mid, Far) 📏
- Camera display option added to the pause menu to switch between: Fullscreen / Windowed 🪟
- Camera following style option added to switch between: Fixed / Smooth 📸
- Backward climbing bug fixed 🪲
- Minor bugs and improvements 🐱

Version: 1.0.5

Thank you to everyone who reported bugs and shared your thoughts on what could be improved!

Best, 
Gabriel

notes.title: Chef's Speed Hunt: Seeking the Fastest Hirocato Players!
notes.content:
Cato's boss, Chef, is on the lookout for the [b]quickest[/b] Cato players! Think you're fast? Challenge yourself against others on three routes in [url=http://s.team/a/2445060]Hirocato’s Demo[/url].

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44159749/b09fd3eed19ff1cfba672a3e347e4697c0bb4c3a.png[/img]

If you can remain at the #1 spot by the end of the month (02.29.24, 5 PM EST), your name will appear on the Delivery Heroes podium in the game's release version... FOREVER!! 

AND... you'll also get the Mystery Box prize!
